scope: All 32 expanded chart directional variants CH11-CH28; one exact frozen occurrence per variant, not every historic occurrence/timeframe.
source_integrity: No detector, specification, source OHLCV or frozen research event changed. These are drawing-only adjustments and exact-event review records.

findings.detail: Published failure_level was omitted. Added Failure reference verbatim; close-failure rules include ATR buffer and are not stop executions.
Pole top now Pole high/low; mirrored bump bottom now Bump trough.
Peaks 444.25/449.95/447.95, valleys 417.70/346.05; setup only with frozen neckline 346.05. Present implementation has no valley-comparability rule. Presentation cannot repair classification.
Widest high index 126 vs widest low 92; separation 34 of formation 66 bars. Predicate accepts opposite middle extrema without a timing-alignment gate. Correct overlay appears strongly skewed.
Straight guides reproduce named extrema, not an unavailable fitted curve.
Gallery did not prominently show frozen setup/confirmed state; drawing complete was only an animation state but could imply completed pattern.
Long sample named pivot 425.35 is later undercut by wick 420.45; all subsequent closes stay above 425.35-0.12*4.8025 before confirmation. Do not replace the causal pivot with a future extreme.
Dashed mathematical-intersection caveat visually verified on CH11/14/23. Final CH26 bearish and bullish cards visibly state: Blue: measured-move target (a projection, not an observed outcome).
